Gotham Veterinary and Canine Rehab have been an amazing part of our lives. My dog Cobweb was born with some hip issues so we started at Canine Rehab when she was a little puppy as preventative medicine. She's about to turn 3 and it's her favorite place in the world. She'd live there if she could. I know there was a worry when Olga moved back home about the future of Canine Rehab but Molly, Gabby, and Chelsea have been outstanding in her stead. Cob is a bundle of energy and they always greet her with excitement even if she's being a handful. I also so appreciate how accommodating they've been with scheduling. Chelsea knows I suffer from chronic migraines and, while I do my best to not have to reschedule last minute, if there is a day that I wake up extremely ill, they are AMAZING at helping me get Cob in that same week so she doesn't go without care. I will be a Canine Rehab fangirl forever.
